---
title: "Nterminal Enriched DDA `r params$title`"
subtitle: "`r params$subtitle`"
author: "`r params$author`"
format: 
  html:
    fig-width: 12
    fig-height: 10
    toc: true
    toc-title: 'N-term Report'
    title-block-banner: '#1b2944'
    title-block-banner-color: '#f79646'

execute: 
  echo: false
  warning: false
embed-resources: true
theme: 
 - layout/brand 
 - layout/custom.scss

params:
  description: ""
  design_file: ""
  input_file: ""
  folder_prj: ""
  title: ""
  subtitle: ""
  author: "" 
  select_group: ""
  sample_stat: ""
  grp_stat: ""
  glb_stat: ""
  grp_uniqprot: ""
  sample_uniqprot: ""
  acetyl_stat: ""
  acd4_stat: ""
---


```{css css_set_up}
/* Custom CSS for better visualization */
.card {
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.card-header {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
}

.card-body {
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.badge {
  font-size: 0.9em;
  padding: 0.5em 1em;
}

.elements-table {
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.dataTables_wrapper {
  padding: 10px;
}
.card-header {
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.card-header:hover {
  background-color: #e9ecef;
}

.collapse-icon {
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.card-header[aria-expanded="true"] .collapse-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* Animate collapse */
.collapse {
  transition: height 0.35s ease;
}

/* Optional: Style to show which card is active */
.card-header[aria-expanded="true"] {
  background-color: #e9ecef;
  border-bottom: none;
}

/* Add spacing between header elements */
.card-title {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.card-subtitle {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* Ensure the chevron icon aligns properly */
.fas {
  width: 1em;
  text-align: center;
}
```

```{js js_set_up}
// Add this JavaScript to handle the chevron rotation
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.card-header').forEach(header => {
    header.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const isExpanded = this.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
    });
  });
  
  // Show first card by default (optional)
  const firstCard = document.querySelector('.collapse');
  if (firstCard) {
    new bootstrap.Collapse(firstCard, {
      toggle: false
    }).show();
  }
});
```

```{r import_data}

L <- readLines(params$design_file, n = 1)
    if (grepl(";", L)) expdesign <- read.csv2(params$design_file) else design <- read.csv(params$design_file)

glb_df  <-  readRDS(params$glb_stat )
grp_df <-  readRDS(params$grp_stat )
smp_df <-   readRDS(params$sample_stat )

grp_l <-  readRDS(params$grp_uniqprot )
smp_l <-   readRDS(params$sample_uniqprot )

acetyl_df <-  readRDS(params$acetyl_stat )
acd4_df <-  readRDS(params$acd4_stat)

```

```{r load_packg_set_up}
#| output: false
 required_packages = c("ggrepel","ggplot","reactable",
                       "plotly","DT",'gridExtra','ggVennDiagram','dplyr' ,'logger','pander','yaml','upsetjs','htmltools','purrr')
 ntermreport::check_dependencies(required_packages)

 st=format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")
write(as.yaml(params), file =  file.path( params$folder_prj, paste0("NtermDDA_parameter_",st  , ".yaml")))

theme_custom_vis <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) %+replace%
    theme(
      # leggend
      legend.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85), face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.70), face = "bold"),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#bababa", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = rel(0.85), face = "bold", color = "#1b2944", margin = margin(5,0,5,0))
    )
}

theme_set(theme_custom_vis(base_size = 18))

if (all(params$select_group != '')) {
  log_info(paste0('Selected groups: ',paste(params$select_group,collapse = ' '  )))
  grp_l <- grp_l[params$select_group]
  #grp_ <- params$select_group
  grp_names <-  params$select_group
}else{
   #grp_ <- unique(expdesign$Group)
   grp_names <- unique(expdesign$Group)}


```

# Statistics 



## Global Level 

```{r glb_viz}

DT::datatable( glb_df ,
             extensions = c('FixedColumns', 'Scroller'),
             options = list(fixedColumns = TRUE, scrollY = 400, scrollX = TRUE,
                            scroller = TRUE, dom = 'Bfrtip', autoWidth = TRUE
             ),
 ) %>%  formatRound(columns = 'percentage', digits = 4)  


```


## Group Level 

```{r grp_viz}

reactable(grp_df, groupBy = "group", columns = list(
  percentage = colDef(format = colFormat(percent = FALSE, digits = 2,suffix='%'))
  )
)
```



## Sample Level 

```{r smp_viz}


reactable(smp_df, groupBy = "sample", columns = list(
  percentage = colDef(format = colFormat(percent = FALSE, digits = 2,suffix='%'))
  ))
```


# Unique Proteins Detected 

##  Among Group 

```{r grp_venn}
upsetjs() %>%  fromList(grp_l ) %>% generateDistinctIntersections()

## other library
#upset(fromList(grp_l), order.by = "freq", nsets = length(listInput) )

all_elements <- unique(unlist(grp_l))

# Build logical membership table
intersection_df <- data.frame(
  Elements = all_elements,
  sapply(names(grp_l), function(nm) all_elements %in% grp_l[[nm]])
)

all_intersections <- ntermreport::get_all_intersections(intersection_df)

#ggVennDiagram(grp_l, fill_color = c("#ec6628", "#41b7b8"))
```
```{r grp_list_intersection}
#| results: asis
      cat('<div class="accordion" id="intersection-accordion">')

  # Sort intersections by count (descending)
  sorted_names <- names(all_intersections)[order(
    sapply(all_intersections, function(x) x$count),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )]

  # Generate individual sections for each intersection
  for (name in sorted_names) {
    data <- all_intersections[[name]]
    
  # Prepare parameters for the child document
    lista <- list(
      name = name,
      count = data$count,
      elements = data$elements,
      set_indicators = ntermreport::create_set_indicators(data$sets)
    )
    
    ntermreport::render_child(data = lista ,
                 label = '' , 
                 path= "",  
                 template='_template_intersection.Rmd') 
  }
   cat('</div>')
```

for (g in grp_names) {
    log_info( paste0('  --  ',g)) 

    #cmp_label <- gsub(params$contrast,'',cmp )
    cat( '## ', paste(g,sep=' '), '\n\n')
    cat ('Upset plot of the unique protein found in each sample \n')
    sample_ <- expdesign %>% filter(Group == g ) %>% pull(Sample)
    my_list_refined <- smp_l[sample_]
    
    ntermreport::render_child(data = my_list_refined ,
                 label = g , 
                 path= "",  
                 template='_template_upsetDIAG.Rmd') 
    ## -- visual intersections elements ------
    all_elements <- unique(unlist(my_list_refined))

  # Build logical membership table
   intersection_df_ <- data.frame(
    Elements = all_elements,
    sapply(names(my_list_refined), function(nm) all_elements %in% my_list_refined[[nm]])
  )

    all_intersections_ <- ntermreport::get_all_intersections(intersection_df_)

    cat('<div class="accordion" id="intersection-accordion">')

  # Sort intersections by count (descending)
  sorted_names <- names(all_intersections_)[order(
    sapply(all_intersections_, function(x) x$count),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )]

  # Generate individual sections for each intersection
  for (name in sorted_names) {
    data_ <- all_intersections_[[name]]
    
  # Prepare parameters for the child document
    lista_ <- list(
      name = name,
      count = data_$count,
      elements = data_$elements,
      set_indicators = ntermreport::create_set_indicators(data_$sets)
    )
    
    ntermreport::render_child(data = lista_ ,
                 label = '' , 
                 path= "",  
                 template='_template_intersection.Rmd') 
  }   
  # close for the vis.intersection      
  cat('</div>')

}

# Acetyl peptides across group 

## TIS 

```{r acetyl_tis}

my_list <- list()
my_protein <- list()

for ( g_ in grp_names) {
  my_list[[g_]] <- acetyl_df[[g_]]$p_start_$pep_seq
  #my_deb[[g_]] <- acetyl_df[[g_]]$p_start_
  my_protein[[g_]] <-  acetyl_df[[g_]]$p_start %>% select(prot_acc,pep_seq,prot_desc)
}

## select(prot_acc,pep_seq, prot_desc )
#ann_df <- reduce(my_protein, function(x, y) left_join(x, y, by = c("prot_acc", "pep_seq")))

ann_df <- bind_rows(my_protein) %>% distinct(prot_acc, pep_seq,prot_desc)
saveRDS(ann_df,'c:\\Users\\Andrea/workspace\\ntermreport\\prot_df.Rds')

upsetjs() %>%  fromList(my_list ) %>%  generateDistinctIntersections()

all_elements <- unique(unlist(my_list))

# Build logical membership table
intersection_df <- data.frame(
  Elements = all_elements,
  sapply(names(my_list), function(nm) all_elements %in% my_list[[nm]])
)

all_intersections <- ntermreport::get_all_intersections(intersection_df)

saveRDS(all_intersections,'c:\\Users\\Andrea\\workspace\\ntermreport\\interaction.Rds')
```
```{r acetyl_tis_intersection}
#| results: asis
      cat('<div class="accordion" id="intersection-accordion">')

  # Sort intersections by count (descending)
  sorted_names <- names(all_intersections)[order(
    sapply(all_intersections, function(x) x$count),
    decreasing = TRUE
  )]

  # Generate individual sections for each intersection
  for (name in sorted_names) {
    data <- all_intersections[[name]]
    
    prot_map <- ann_df %>%
     filter(pep_seq %in% data$elements) %>%
     group_by(pep_seq) %>%
     summarise(proteins = list(prot_acc),  protein_description = list(prot_desc) ,.groups = "drop")

  # Prepare parameters for the child document
    lista <- list(
      name = name,
      count = data$count,
      elements = data$elements,
      proteins =   prot_map %>% 
                  mutate(protein_ids = sapply(proteins, paste, collapse = "; ")) %>% 
                  pull(protein_ids),
      protein_description =   prot_map %>%    
                  mutate(protein_description = sapply(protein_description, paste, collapse = "; ")) %>%
                  pull(protein_description) ,
      set_indicators = ntermreport::create_set_indicators(data$sets)
    )
    log_info(name)
    log_info(length(lista$proteins))
    log_info(length(lista$protein_description))
    log_info(length(lista$elements))
    
  
    ntermreport::render_child(data = lista ,
                 label = 'protein' , 
                 path= "",  
                 template='_template_intersection.Rmd') 
  }

  cat('</div>') 
```
